edits.before: You out-range Sylas hard early: his Chain Lash (E) and healing depend on getting close, and your charged Arcanopulse (Q) hits from well outside his lash range. Poke him whenever he steps to CS, land Eye of Destruction (W) into Q, and refuse to let him trade on his terms. His Kingslayer (W) sustain only matters if he can land damage on you first, so keep the gap and he can't heal. Control the lane from range and tax every approach.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Shocking Orb for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Abscond/Abduct is 13s at rank 1 and 9s maxed at 400 range — the dash into chain-stun, so step up only on its downtime. - Budget your 13s E for emergencies and the 130s R for opportunities — never swap them.
